annotations.title: Google Business attributes available for a listing

description: The ATTRIBUTES a Business Profile can set — accessibility, amenities, service options, payment types — with the valid values for each. These are what local searchers FILTER on, so a listing with none set is invisible to those filters. Scope it exactly ONE of three ways and no more: locationName (`locations/123`) for what THAT listing may set, categoryName (`categories/gcid:…`, from list_business_categories) for a category, or regionCode for a country. Passing more than one is refused by name, because Google silently ignores the ones it does not use and would answer about a different scope than you asked for. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs Google Business Profile connected.
